subject.title: fix(android): localize chat bubble role labels

question: Should the current Android chat rebuild retain or restore native localization for these role labels despite the repository's deferred broad i18n direction?
rationale: The branch follows an older nativeString pattern, while current main removed that path and the broad localization tracker was closed during architectural changes; code inspection alone cannot determine whether that removal was temporary or intentional.

options.title: Restore narrow Android localization
options.body: Approve localization for these existing role labels, but require a current-main implementation using the Android owner's canonical resource architecture.

options.title: Defer with broader i18n
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep the labels English until maintainers establish the next Android localization architecture.

recommendation.title: Restore narrow Android localization
recommendation.body: Approve localization for these existing role labels, but require a current-main implementation using the Android owner's canonical resource architecture.

likelyOwner.reason: The Android README names this person as the app owner, and the decision depends on the ongoing Android rebuild architecture.
